## Findings and implementation (commit 4bf065d8ac4, not yet pushed)

Pre-fix CloudWatch evidence, 1-minute Sum of rebar/host:voter_errors on 2026-11-21 (PST): 06:15 = 1 (boto3 at the 06:15:50 error), 06:20 = 1 (probe), 06:35 = 1 (boto3 at 06:35:51), 06:36 = 1 (probe). 2 VOTER_ERROR markers in the journal, 4 counts.

Metrics published by both review-bot code and observability.sh:
- voter_errors: both, both dimensionless. Double-counted. Fixed: voter.py no longer publishes it.
- review_bot_merge_change_errors: both. The probe publishes it dimensionless (the stream rebar-review-bot-merge-change-errors watches); voter_merge.py published it with a `reason` dimension, which CloudWatch keeps as separate streams, so the alarm stream was not doubled. No alarm, dashboard or doc reads the reason-tagged stream. Fixed anyway so the probe is the single publisher; the reason stays in the MERGE_CHANGE_ERROR journal record.
- review_bot_artifact_emit_errors: only artifact_emit.py publishes it; the probe has no ARTIFACT_EMIT_ERROR section and no alarm reads it. Not double-counted; kept, docstring corrected.
- review_bot_llm_* token metrics: only voter.py; kept.

Guard test tests/unit/test_review_bot_single_metric_publisher.py reads both probe publishing shapes (`--metric-name <name>` and `publish_autodeploy_marker_delta '<re>' <name>`), finds MetricName values anywhere in a review-bot module that calls put_metric_data (including lists built before the call and f-string prefixes), and fails on any name it cannot resolve. Run against origin/main's voter.py and voter_merge.py it reports voter_errors and review_bot_merge_change_errors; on the fix it passes. ADR 0009 §Observability updated to match.
